status: Proposed design expectations; no production repair evaluator was executed.

contract.refAliases: A row ref such as c1 is a test alias only. Resolve it through the named snapshot to (sourceId,snapshotId,zeroBasedOrdinal). Never persist the alias or infer cross-refresh occurrence identity from it.
contract.scalarTags: A one-property object {$scalar: NAME} represents the runtime scalar undefined, NaN, Infinity, -Infinity, or -0. It is fixture notation, not a proposed unescaped production JSON codec.
contract.keys: Ordered tuples of actual scalar values. Finite numbers, booleans, and nonblank strings only. No coercion or trim of nonblank text. -0 and +0 share key identity; raw row equality distinguishes them.
contract.exact: All data fields and own-property presence, preserving scalar type, undefined/null/absence, nonfinite atoms, and signed zero. Positively marked generated source-row-number metadata alone is omitted from equality and prepared output, but preserved in original archives. A mere field name never excludes it. Test alias refs do not participate.
contract.winnerRefs: All exact original copies of the selected whole-row value class. No copy is semantically privileged.
contract.representedRefs: Equal to winnerRefs in this bounded design. Losing conflicting rows are excluded, not represented as if their values survived.
contract.excluded: Every intentionally excluded original has an explicit reason; unresolved originals remain separately listed.
contract.blocked: previewOutputs are inspection candidates only. usableOutputCount=null means no current usable prepared target, not an empty table and not a partial subset.
contract.relationshipCounts: matched includes ambiguous; expandedExtra sums max(matchCount-1,0). innerRows sums matchCount; leftRows adds one row for every unmatched input.
contract.refresh: Reorder-only with the same semantic multiset stays ready and retains its accepted evidence snapshot. Any content change leaves current dependent results unavailable until an accepted refresh. Prior values and every prior original are retained as labeled historical evidence.
contract.expectations: Expected winners, memberships, counts, and aggregates were hand-enumerated. verify_fixtures.py checks internal invariants and arithmetic; it is not the proposed repair implementation.

cases.title: Ambiguous relationship to reusable repaired target and notebook
Chosen equal fields do not authorize exact-record collapse
Legitimate repeated events survive a change of declared grain
Ordered composite tuples avoid delimiters and type collisions
Missing blank and nonfinite keys retain separate original evidence
Latest earliest equivalent timestamps and exact top twins
Ordering parsing is explicit and does not redefine exact equality

textOrderingVector.normalization: none; whitespace is tested only for all-blank eligibility and otherwise retained verbatim
textOrderingVector.dateOrderingBoundary: Date order accepts string values under the rule's saved parser preset; numeric epoch date interpretation is deferred. Numeric ordering remains a separate supported mode.

cases.title: Refresh preserves history and revalidates manual group guards
Dependency failures cannot masquerade as a valid empty repaired source
A repaired entity key does not make every relationship field unique
Entity-aware measure conflict policy stays independent of duplicate repair
Persistence keeps original scalar evidence and transitive dependencies
cases.baselineCodecLimitation: Baseline projectFile handles undefined/NaN/+Infinity/-Infinity and escapes its reserved marker; -0 requires a proposed extension for lossless evidence. Fixture tags are not a claim of a shipped wire format.

cases.title: Exact whole-row equality preserves property presence types and signed zero
Generated row numbers require metadata and never a name heuristic
Full-source apply cancel undo and concurrent refresh
keyboardAcceptance: Arrow keys move between whole-row alternatives
Apply reachable by Tab and named by visible text
